correctness.rationale: Let D={T(gX)<T(X)}. On D^c every sampled transform gives comparison success so P_M=1; on D the number of successes equals Bin(M,a), independent of X. On each length-l g-cycle invariance gives uniform X and at most l-1 directed strict score descents; therefore Pr(D)<=delta_L=1-1/L, attained by one descending cycle. Every grid threshold exactly has maximal rejection delta_L F_{M,a}(k-1), so M inequalities characterize universal validity. Lower-binomial CDF monotone in a gives interval of safe masses. Size-bias identity with Bin(M+1,a) proves strict safety at a=delta_L and continuity gives a_M,L<delta_L; LLN proves limit. Independent direct enumeration of maximal strict cyclic score orderings and all 2^M transformation strings for L=2..6, M=1..4 and a in {0,1/4,1/2,3/4,1} matched the exact rational formula; finite verification is not all-M proof.
